svg.title: ROVER recursive reasoning over videos for embodied tasks
svg.desc: Editable recreation of a three-level robot task decomposition diagram. Text, panels, arrows, and recursion nodes are separate SVG objects; scene frames are embedded raster crops.

text.tspan: Task: “Thaw the steak in the microwave”

g.text: The gripper is in front of microwave...
The robot opened the microwave door.
The robot put the steak in the microwave.
The gripper is in front of microwave...
The robot fully grasped the door handle.
The robot opened the microwave door.
The gripper is in front of microwave...
The gripper moved closer to the door...
The robot fully grasped the door...
